versions.changelog:
- Major refactor: skill was simplified with most Python code and scripts removed.
- SKILL.md restructured and updated for clarity, with enhanced metadata and improved platform summaries.
- Documentation greatly condensed; details now reference QUICKSTART.md and companion guides.
- Most implementation files, scripts, and secondary docs deleted; setup is now external or delegated.
- Troubleshooting, license, and configuration sections streamlined.
- Sub-skill loading, naming, and CLI instructions clarified.

- Added user guides for Hermes and OpenClaw platforms (docs/hermes-guide.md, docs/openclaw-guide.md)
- Updated skill code and documentation to support new guides
- Minor improvements and maintenance in core files (README.md, auth.py, installer.py, pyproject.toml)
- No changes to the public API or skill interface

- Initial public Python release with CLI, modular architecture, and core gateway skill system.
- Added main feyagate CLI tool and service lifecycle management (setup/start/stop/status/log/upgrade/auth).
- Introduced cross-platform device control and status tools for Xiaomi, Tuya, Midea, eWeLink, serial, GPIO.
- Integrated sub-skill system (automation, extension, platform-specific skills) with trigger-based loading.
- Included advanced manual install scripts, full documentation, and API references.
- Implemented license management: free (Xiaomi-only) and licensed (all platforms) editions.

Feyagate-skill 1.0.6 Changelog

- Added detailed SKILL.md documentation describing cross-platform smart home gateway usage, endpoints, commands, and modular sub-skills.
- Sub-skills for Xiaomi, Tuya, Midea, eWeLink, Automation, and Extension now documented with triggers and usage guidance.
- Included CLI usage for installation, status, authentication, and manual scripts for Linux/macOS/Windows.
- Provided license requirement details distinguishing free vs. licensed features.
- Added configuration sample and troubleshooting guide for common setup and runtime issues.
- Outlined the recommended workflow for integrating with compatible AI agents and platforms.
